description.en: Image generation through the Volcano Ark / Doubao Seedream API: ark_generate_image handles text-to-image, image-to-image with reference images and fixed-seed batches, ark_image_gen_status checks the key, model and output directory, and a bundled skill explains both.
description.zh: 火山方舟 / 豆包 Seedream 生图：ark_generate_image 支持文生图、带参考图的图生图和固定 seed 批量出图，ark_image_gen_status 检查密钥、模型与输出目录，并内置一份用法说明。
